crawl: 2026-09-09 Chrome live crawl at 06:00 Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh (sequential fetch, cache:no-store, AbortController 15s)
method: Chrome MCP same-origin fetch of raw HTML for all 103 pages + rendered-DOM spot checks on /, /articles and /projects/251-station-st. Every internal link target cross-checked against the crawled set. No OpenSEO, no Supermetrics.

score_rationale.crawlability: 77 -> 93. /articles hub now exposes 80/80 article links in source HTML (was 7/79); orphans 17 -> 0; 103/103 return 200; 0 timeouts; sitemap complete. Held below the 97 of 28 Aug by 10 legacy long-slug URLs that return 200 with self-canonical (duplicate content) and 1 malformed internal link returning 404.
score_rationale.performance: 87 -> 88. Site-wide mean 877 -> 833 ms, under-1s 76 -> 81/103, articles 891 -> 823, projects 701 -> 635, 0 pages over 3s. Only +1 because the homepage measured 1,988 ms and re-measured 2,103/2,537/1,534 ms (four readings above 1.5 s).
score_rationale.structured_data: 95 -> 94. 101/103 pages with schema, duplication 1.0x, but FAQPage fell a third consecutive day to 65/80 (81.3%) as the new article shipped without it.
score_rationale.onpage: 92 (flat). 103/103 one h1 + title + meta + canonical; 1 template image lacks alt on every page; heading skips re-measured with the standard rule = 1 article (bim-3d-4d-5d-explained, 4 points) instead of the 15 pages carried since 28 Aug; offset by the 10 self-canonical legacy URLs (new canonical defect).
score_rationale.content: 90 (flat). 215,236 words (+2,229), article average 2,548, core average 584 (hub 328 -> 1,043 words), 11 thin pages unchanged; 10 duplicate legacy URLs count against it.

ttfb_ms.finding: Articles and projects faster than yesterday; the homepage is the only page moving the wrong way, with four readings between 1,534 and 2,537 ms (mean 2,040) - outside the +/-100 ms noise band. Browser navigation timing of 1,136 ms suggests the CDN copy is still fast and the no-store fetch is reaching a slow origin. Treat as a regression only if the next crawl confirms it. development-application-3d-render re-measured 1,848 -> 877 ms, confirming yesterday's cold-cache reading.

schema.note: The 10 legacy long-slug URLs also emit their own Article block, so 10 articles currently declare two Article entities for the same content.

heading_skips.rule: a heading more than one level deeper than the previous heading (H1->H3, H2->H4)
heading_skips.note: Re-measured from scratch in raw HTML and confirmed in rendered DOM for /projects/251-station-st and /articles: the 15-page figure carried since 28 Aug could not be reproduced. Project pages run H1 -> H2 (Location, Timeframe, Technologies, Related projects) -> H3 -> H4.

onpage.internal_links_method: From this report: unique internal links only (#hash/?query folded, static assets, external and tel:/mailto: excluded) - same as the 4 Sep report. The 7-8 Sep passes also counted 5 social links and contact links, hence ~6 more per page. Not a site change.
